brandCovers.layout: Portrait 4:5 editorial product still life; quiet lower quarter for website caption.
brandCovers.constraints: Unbranded garments and accessories only; no people, faces, body parts, mannequins, logos, text, or copied campaigns.
brands: preppy American sportswear: a folded navy cable-knit sweater, ivory oxford button-down, deep red tie and neatly folded indigo denim, arranged on warm ivory linen with a small dark oak accent; restrained navy, cream and burgundy palette

contemporary luxury streetwear: sculptural oversized charcoal hoodie, ivory heavyweight boxy tee, black cargo trousers and a matte silver chain arranged across dark concrete plinths; confident monochrome styling and soft hard-edged shadows

dramatic Italian evening luxury: lustrous black satin garment draped in sculptural folds, tailored black jacket edge, polished gold chain accessories and a subtle ornate gold fabric accent on warm dark stone; black-and-gold editorial richness without recognizable branded prints

modern performance sportswear: lightweight black running shorts, folded slate technical tee, white athletic socks and an unbranded training shoe on light concrete, with a restrained vivid red cord accent and dynamic diagonal composition

archive-inspired sport and streetwear: navy zip-front track jacket with solid cream piping, ivory ribbed tee, clean white low-top unbranded sneakers and a dark baseball cap on pale stone; restrained navy-and-cream retro sports aesthetic, no stripes or logos

minimalist modern essentials: crisp white cotton tee, folded black denim and a plain charcoal cotton layer, precise negative space and clean geometry on warm ivory stone; sophisticated black, white and soft grey palette

heritage Ivy-inspired menswear: oatmeal cable-knit sweater, pale blue oxford shirt, burgundy tie, brown leather belt and folded tan chinos on warm oak beside cream linen; polished understated heritage styling

directional urban tailoring: sharply cut black blazer, folded charcoal tailored trousers, plain white poplin shirt and a narrow muted red fabric accent on geometric grey stone plinths; architectural, contemporary city wardrobe

heritage tennis styling: forest green pique polo shirt, cream knit layer, crisp white shorts, plain tennis racket and two tennis balls on pale sage and ivory studio surface; refined country-club sports palette
